sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Single-Origin Green Arabica Coffee Bean Container Distribution

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu (unitary national jurisdiction; no sub-state tax distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English Common Law / French Civil Law / Customary Kastom law; company and AML law closely follows English common law models)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: No comprehensive Double Taxation Agreement in force; Vanuatu operates a no-income-tax regime and International Companies are wholly tax-exempt
PACER-Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus), in force since 2020
SPARTECA (South Pacific Regional Trade and Economic Cooperation Agreement) - non-reciprocal preferences with Australia and New Zealand

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 22 of 2011 (as amended); Financial Intelligence Unit Act No. 9 of 2011 (as amended); International Companies Act No. 32 of 1992 [Cap. 222], as amended (including the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2014, which added ss. 51A-51D on beneficial ownership records); Registered Agents and Service Providers Act No. 14 of 2011; AML/CFT (Prescribed Transactions) Regulations 2012; AML/CFT Code of Practice 2013. Vanuatu was listed under FATF 'Jurisdictions under Increased Monitoring' (grey list) in February 2023 and remains under increased monitoring; enhanced KYC/EDD discipline applies.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (beneficial ownership register is kept privately by the VFSC-licensed registered agent; no public UBO registry; VFIU/VFSC may access on lawful request; nominee shareholders/directors are permissible but must be declared to the registered agent under International Companies Act ss. 51A-51D)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport for each director, shareholder, and UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport issuing authority of the country of nationality
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notary attestation followed by Hague Apostille (Vanuatu is an Apostille Convention Contracting Party since 2008); consular legalization only if the issuing state is not an Apostille Contracting State

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement dated within 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or home-country licensed bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Hague Apostille or consular legalization as applicable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original banker's reference letter on bank letterhead
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country financial institution holding the applicant's account

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Beneficial ownership declaration and group structure chart signed by each ultimate owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Applicant shareholders, executed before a notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization; apostille where required by the VFSC-licensed registered agent's internal policy

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: For any corporate shareholder: certified copy of certificate of incorporation, register of directors/members, and certificate of good standing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, UBOs, and authorized signatories against the UN Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK HMT sanctions list, and VFIU domestic regulatory alerts; mandatory PEP identification incl. family members and close associates (AML/CFT Act ss. 13-15); PEP status requires enhanced due diligence, senior-management approval, and source-of-funds verification; adverse screening results trigger immediate STR filing to the VFIU and refusal of the engagement where risk cannot be mitigated; ongoing transaction monitoring applies to Swift_Wire and Documentary_LC rails.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Companies Registry - 'Name Reservation and Company Search' facility (public portal vfsc.vu); applications are filed electronically by a VFSC-licensed International Company registered agent.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be in Latin script (English, French, or Bislama); all non-Latin names (e.g., Arabic, Cyrillic, CJK) must be transliterated into Latin script; the name must end in 'Limited', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Societe Anonyme' or the abbreviations 'Ltd', 'Corp', 'Inc', 'SA'; the name must not be identical or deceptively similar to any name on the VFSC index; use of 'Vanuatu' or 'New Hebrides' requires VFSC consent.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the licensed registered agent files a written request for reconsideration with the VFSC Registrar within 14 days (International Companies Act ss. 15-16); the Registrar typically issues a response within 21 days; the fastest commercial remedy is a fresh reservation under an amended name; where the Registrar confirms refusal, the applicant may institute judicial review before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu; an expiring reservation may be renewed for one additional term upon written application and payment of the prevailing VFSC fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual or mail-forwarding office is acceptable for operational back-office purposes only; the statutory registered office must be a physical address in Vanuatu (typically the licensed registered agent's office in Port Vila) where legal process and official notices can be served; a P.O. Box alone does not satisfy the International Companies Act [Cap. 222].
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low - estimated below 5% annual probability absent risk triggers. The activity (ISIC 4631 / NAICS 424490 specialty green coffee container distribution) is license-exempt, is classified Low_Risk_Standard for AML, and uses Swift_Wire and Documentary_LC payment rails only; VFSC/VFIU risk-based supervision focuses on on-site inspection of the licensed registered agent rather than the offshore IC's own premises.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee under International Companies Act [Cap. 222] and VFSC fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: International Company incorporation and registration government fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration fee under the International Companies (Fees) Regulations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent and registered office service - first year
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing Port Vila TCSP market benchmark under Registered Agents and Service Providers Act No. 14 of 2011

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Compulsory KYC, UBO, PEP, and sanctions screening due diligence pack
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for fulfillment of AML/CFT Act No. 22 of 2011 and International Companies Act ss. 51A-51D obligations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of certified passport, address proof, and UBO declarations
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary Public in the applicant's jurisdiction
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing notarial tariff in country of origin

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille certification of KYC documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent apostille authority in the country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing governmental fee for apostille issuance

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Consular legalization contingency (activated only for documents from non-Apostille Contracting States)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Vanuatu consular post or designated commercial legalization service
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Contingency line; zero cost in the standard apostille route

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: International courier of certified and apostilled KYC documents (DHL/FedEx)
Post-incorporation Certificate of Incumbency and Certificate of Good Standing (initial set)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: VFSC fee schedule plus TCSP market benchmark

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 222] of Vanuatu, sections 4 (incorporation), 6 (memorandum and articles), 7 (registered agent), 8 (registered office), 12 (share capital) and 40 (directors and secretary).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registry Division, Private Mail Bag 9017, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association filed on Form IC-1 (Application for Incorporation of an International Company).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement under the International Companies Act; authorised share capital is at the subscriber's discretion in any currency; no escrow account or banked capital is required for incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, by unanimous consent of the first directors of the Company: (1) That the subscribers subscribe for and take up 1,000 ordinary shares of no par value at US$0.01 per share, fully paid; (2) That the registered office located at [address], Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu is adopted as the statutory registered office of the Company; (3) That [Director 1] and [Director 2] be appointed directors and [Secretary] be appointed company secretary, each to serve until the first annual general meeting; (4) That the directors are authorised to open bank accounts, seal documents, and complete all filings with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission. Adopted on the date of incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Companies Registry online portal, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a name search in the VFSC e-Registry system to confirm that the proposed company name and a first alternative do not conflict with existing trade names, trademarks, or prohibited words. Submit the formal name reservation application with two alternative names and pay the search fee, if applicable.
required_dossiers: Declaration as to the proposed name
Passport or national ID copies of subscriber(s)
Proof of residential address of subscriber(s)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, immediately file a new reservation using the second alternative; a written appeal may be lodged with the VFSC Registrar within 14 days of the refusal decision.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engagement of a Licensed Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed company agents (registered agents) in Vanuatu
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Appoint a VFSC-licensed registered agent for the International Company as mandated by the International Companies Act. Execute the registered agent agreement, complete customer due diligence and beneficial ownership declarations, and obtain the agent's written consent to act.
required_dossiers: KYC and AML questionnaire for subscribers and directors
Consent letter from the VFSC-licensed agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed agent declines to act due to due diligence gaps, provide enhanced documentation or engage another licensed agent; VFSC maintains a public register of approved agents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Constitutive Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporate law firm or licensed agent in Vanuatu; subscriber(s)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in the statutory form, set out authorised share capital and share classes, appoint initial directors and secretary, and have the subscriber(s) execute the documents. Ensure each director signs a consent to act and the secretary signs a consent form.
required_dossiers: Consent to act as director of each initial director
Consent to act as secretary of the company secretary
Registered office address confirmation within Vanuatu
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC queries the form or content, the law firm or registered agent is instructed to revise and re-execute the constitutive documents within five business days and resubmit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application to VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Companies Registry, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the complete application on Form IC-1 together with the executed Memorandum and Articles, director and secretary consents, registered agent consent and registered office details. Pay the statutory incorporation fee (approximately US$250). VFSC will issue the Certificate of Incorporation upon approval.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent to act of directors and secretary
Certified passport copies of directors and shareholders
Proof of payment of incorporation fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC issues a deficiency notice, remedy the stated omissions within 21 days, amend or re-execute affected documents, and pay any additional administrative fee; expedited 24-hour processing may be requested for sufficient cause.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation First Board Meeting and Governance Adoption
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company directors and company secretary (acting under Memorandum and Articles)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting or adopt a unanimous written resolution in the pro-forma form, formally subscribing shares, adopting the registered office, appointing officers, authorising bank account openings, adopting the company seal, and approving the register of members and other statutory books.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If quorum issues arise, convene an adjourned meeting within 48 hours or rely on unanimous written resolutions as permitted by the International Companies Act; rectify any defective share allotment by board ratification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Business Licence and Customs Registration (Conditional on Physical Presence)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) – Business Licence Desk; Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: For an International Company that transacts business wholly outside Vanuatu, no Vanuatu business licence is required. Should the company establish a physical warehouse, branch office, or import customs clearance in Vanuatu, it must apply for a General Business Licence under the Business Licence Act and register for an import/export code with Customs; business activities are classified as general wholesale of green coffee beans.
required_dossiers: Lease or ownership title of the business premises
National Provident Fund registration (if hiring local staff)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Business Licence application is refused, file a written appeal with the Minister responsible for commerce within 21 days, amend the premises or scope description, and obtain municipal zoning approval where required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Environmental and Civil Defence Clearances for Physical Warehouse (If Established)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC); Vanuatu Fire and Rescue Services; Department of Labour – Occupational Health and Safety Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: If a warehouse or container-handling facility is established within Vanuatu, submit a Preliminary Environmental Assessment to DEPC for low-impact storage, obtain a fire safety certificate from the Fire and Rescue Services, secure structural clearance from the Public Works Department, and register the workplace with the OHS Division.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a clearance is conditioned or refused, comply with the stated mitigation measures and resubmit; unresolved disputes may be escalated to the Minister of Climate Change and Environment for DEPC matters or to the Commissioner of Labour for OHS matters.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA), Port Vila Municipal Council, and Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue for import and warehousing controls.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: General Business Licence (under the Business Licence Act [Cap. 26]) and Import Declaration / Customs Entry for green coffee bean containers (only required when a physical presence or local customs clearance is established).

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change, Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Preliminary Assessment (Low Impact) – Category 2 registration; full Environmental Impact Assessment report not required for closed-container green coffee bean warehousing, repacking and distribution.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No point-source process wastewater from coffee bean handling; stormwater run-off from warehouse yards must meet IFC/World Bank EHS Guidelines for ambient water quality (BOD ≤ 30 mg/L, TSS ≤ 50 mg/L); no VOC or particulate emissions are generated; fumigation residue and container cleaning waste must be managed per the Waste Management Act and Plant Biosecurity regulations; packaging waste to be segregated and recycled or disposed of at an approved facility.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the Vanuatu Fire and Rescue Services; structural load and floor-bearing inspection certificate from the Vanuatu Public Works Department; occupational health and safety workplace registration from the Department of Labour; if customs-bonded storage is used, a Customs Bonded Warehouse Approval from the Comptroller of Customs is additionally required.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Authority (VRCA), Customs & Excise Division; online filing via ASYCUDA World single window. Company registration and regulatory licensing are administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) under the International Companies Act, Cap 222, with licensed registered agents as mandatory intermediaries. Official portals: www.vrca.gov.vu and www.vfsc.vu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1) Incorporate the International Company (IC) with VFSC through a licensed registered agent; no minimum paid-up capital and no resident director requirement. 2) Apply to VRCA for a Customs Importer/Exporter Code via the ASYCUDA World module only if goods will physically enter or transit Vanuatu customs territory; the VFSC registration number remains the primary legal identifier for the IC. 3) No income tax TIN is issued because Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax, no withholding tax, and no capital gains tax; an IC holding a valid Certificate of Exemption is statutorily outside the national income tax net. 4) For pure offshore trading (coffee sold ex-Vanuatu origin to non-Vanuatu buyers), no VRCA registration is triggered; the IC operates on principal-to-principal contracts with title passing outside Vanuatu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None applicable. Section 112 of the International Companies Act, Cap 222, grants an absolute, non-assessable tax exemption to ICs on all income, profits, distributions, transfers, and capital transactions; no check-the-box election, no hybrid mismatch election, and no residence-based election exists because Vanuatu has no income tax statute. An IC may elect under its constitutional documents to adopt enhanced governance provisions, but such elections have no tax consequence. If the IC engages in prohibited domestic Vanuatu business, the exemption is voidable and penalties under the Act apply.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No national VAT or GST in force. Vanuatu operates a customs duty (import tariff), excise, and stamp duty regime administered by VRCA under the Customs and Excise Act, Cap 121; the IC's offshore green coffee trading does not attract any Vanuatu indirect tax where goods do not enter Vanuatu customs territory.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable - no VAT/GST registration threshold exists. A Customs Importer/Exporter Code in VUV is required only upon the first physical import or transshipment of goods through Vanuatu customs territory; an IC trading coffee wholly offshore without Vanuatu-landfall has no fiscal registration or turnover threshold obligation.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, no digital stamping, and no mandatory e-invoicing/API clearance regime is in force. Electronic customs declarations are lodged through the ASYCUDA World system for all goods entering or leaving Vanuatu; risk assessment is data-driven but not connected to live invoicing. Commercial invoices and packing lists are submitted as structured PDF attachments; there is no continuous transaction control (CTC) clearance protocol.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Formally inapplicable - Vanuatu imposes no VAT/GST, therefore no 0% export VAT claim mechanism exists. However, Vanuatu levies no export duty on green coffee beans, and an IC operating as a pure offshore conduit is entirely outside the customs duty base: goods transshipped or sold free on board (FOB) at a Vanuatu port under bond or free-zone procedures attract no indirect tax. To preserve this neutral position, the IC's documentary evidence must demonstrate the goods were exported or shipped to a foreign destination, the coffee never entered home-use consumption in Vanuatu, and no value was added within Vanuatu customs territory.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: ASYCUDA World Electronic Customs Export Declaration (cargo manifest or export entry, if goods physically use Vanuatu customs territory)
Original Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing foreign destination
Signed Commercial Invoice (green coffee contract proceeds with reference to the VU_IC entity)
Packing List and Certificate of Origin / phytosanitary certificate where applicable
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT credit advice evidencing receipt of export sales proceeds
VFSC Certificate of Incorporation and International Company Act Section 112 tax exemption certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No clawback of export zero-rating exists given the absence of VAT. Fraudulent customs declarations, misdescription of goods, or false use of duty-free/transshipment status are prosecuted under the Customs and Excise Act, Cap 121: fines up to VUV 1,000,000, forfeiture of goods, vessel or aircraft seizure, and imprisonment up to 5 years. An IC that breaches the International Companies Act Cap 222 by engaging in prohibited domestic Vanuatu business loses its Section 112 exemption retroactively for the offending transactions, with recovery of unpaid customs and excise duties and cancellation of registration by VFSC. Anti-money laundering scrutiny applies through licensed registered agents and banks under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 13 of 2014, with penalties for suspicious transaction reporting failures including monetary penalties and sanctions against the entity's license.

stage_4.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant wire transfer protocols, purpose codes, and verification
stage_4.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails for trade settlements (SWIFT MT103, Commercial LC)
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Permissible forwards, NDFs, and currency swaps

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Company Return and Annual Fee under the Vanuatu International Companies Act and International Companies (Fees) Regulations
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the anniversary of the International Company's registration date; payment and filing must be completed within 30 calendar days of each anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing/penalty fee imposed by VFSC; continued failure attracts suspension of the International Company's constitutional documents and certificate of registration, and eventual administrative strike-off following statutory notice.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent / Registered Office Confirmation (Annual affidavit or agent continuing declaration maintained by the VFSC-licensed registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Every 12 months of operation, to coincide with the annual review of the registered office and agent engagement agreement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a Vanuatu registered agent and registered office constitutes an offence under the International Companies Act and can result in penalties and strike-off by the Registrar.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit requirement for International Companies under Vanuatu law; an audit becomes necessary only if expressly required by the company's constitution, shareholders' resolution, or a third-party financing contract (e.g., bank lending or documentary credit facility).
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No prescribed Vanuatu statutory accounting framework for International Companies; companies may adopt IFRS or voluntary accounting standards for internal management, creditor reporting, or due diligence purposes.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No public beneficial ownership register exists under Vanuatu law; the VFSC-licensed registered agent is required to maintain a contemporaneous privately held beneficial ownership record. The agent must annually verify and update shareholder/ownership data for each International Company, including any share transfers occurring during the year, and obtain confirmation from directors that the ownership information remains accurate. There is no filing to a public registry, but the agent's private beneficial ownership records must be maintained and made available to VFSC upon lawful request.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Beneficial Ownership (held by registered agent)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 700 - 1,500 per annum for registered agent and registered office services in Vanuatu, depending on the service provider and inclusion of compliance monitoring.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000 - 8,000 per annum if an independent audit is voluntarily procured for the specialty green coffee bean International Company, depending on transaction volume and complexity.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Company (IC) statutory exemption under s.136 of the International Companies Act [Cap.222]: full exemption from income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, stamp duty and exchange control. Conditions: registered office and licensed agent in Vanuatu, no business with Vanuatu residents, no landholding in Vanuatu, and maintenance of records at the registered office.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No Vanuatu corporate income tax return exists. Mandatory annual compliance instrument: 'International Company Annual Renewal and Compliance Filing' submitted by the registered agent on the VFSC online portal (https://www.vfsc.vu).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on each anniversary date of incorporation; a 60-day grace period is allowed; from day 61, late fees accrue at 10% per month of the annual government fee.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: IC registration number assigned by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the VFSC number exactly as shown on the Certificate of Incorporation; used to pre-populate the annual fee amount.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal name including the 'Limited' suffix.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No trading name is permitted unless separately registered; the name must match SWIFT and documentary-credit documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in Vanuatu (must be the registered agent's physical address in Port Vila).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cannot be a PO Box; coffee supply contracts and shipping documents should reference this address for substance evidence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Licensed registered agent details and agent declaration.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent must be licensed under the International Companies Act and the AML/CFT Act; non-resident directors must instruct the agent in writing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Current register of directors and shareholders with nationality, passport number and residential address.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Proof of identity must be certified; beneficial owners must be disclosed to the agent for the central beneficial-ownership registry.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised and issued share capital schedule.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum paid-up capital applies; par value and currency may be in any currency including USD for green-coffee LC transactions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Annual declaration of continued exemption: no business with Vanuatu residents; no Vanuatu land; no banking, insurance, or trust/company-service-provider activities.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If green-coffee containers are never cleared through Vanuatu customs and no Vanuatu-resident customer exists, select 'none of the prohibited activities apply'.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Payment of the annual government fee in VUV (amount prescribed under the International Companies (Fees) Regulations).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reimburse the registered agent promptly; failure to pay triggers the 10% monthly late fee and strike-off risk.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late renewal after the 60-day grace period attracts a VFSC penalty fee of 10% of the annual fee per month or part of a month. Continued non-payment leads to administrative strike-off and deregistration; assets of the IC vest in VFSC; directors may be disqualified from managing any Vanuatu entity for up to 5 years.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% (Vanuatu imposes no tax on dividends paid by an International Company to any shareholder, resident or non-resident).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no broad double-taxation agreement network currently in force; it maintains only Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEAs) with selected jurisdictions. If a limited treaty benefit is invoked, the recipient must: (i) obtain a Tax Residence Certificate from the Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue to the extent issuable; (ii) submit a signed treaty-benefit claim and beneficial-ownership declaration to the Vanuatu paying entity; and (iii) retain the documentation for the recipient's foreign-tax-credit and CRS filings. Because the domestic withholding rate is nil, treaty relief produces no Vanuatu tax reduction.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic statutory rate for royalties and debt interest paid by an IC: 0%. Treaty-reduced rates are not applicable because no effective DTA network exists. Recipients must rely on domestic foreign-tax-credit rules in their residence jurisdiction; CRS reporting on the payment remains mandatory.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None. No statutory transfer-pricing documentation, Local File, Master File or CbC reporting thresholds apply in Vanuatu because no corporate income tax exists. Related-party pricing of green-coffee imports remains relevant only for customs valuation under the Customs Act (duty and 12.5% VAT base at import).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: No formal Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) in the BVI/Cayman model. Substance proxies are nevertheless enforced through: (i) the IC Act requirement of a licensed resident agent, registered office and physical records in Vanuatu; (ii) the prohibition on conducting business with Vanuatu residents; and (iii) AML/CFT beneficial-ownership recording. The VFSC, OECD Global Forum and foreign tax authorities may disregard the IC if the coffee trade is executed without real functions, assets, risks and decision-making in Vanuatu.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax evasion and sham use of IC exemption
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the tax-exempt IC to shelter income economically sourced in Vanuatu, e.g., selling to Vanuatu-resident roasters, operating a Port Vila warehouse, or booking profits from foreign operating entities into the IC without commercial substance, triggering foreign CFC/GAAR recharacterisation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Loss of the IC tax exemption; prosecution under the International Companies Act for prohibited local business; assessment of 12.5% VAT plus interest and penalties by Customs and Inland Revenue; deregistration by VFSC; foreign anti-avoidance adjustments with interest and penalties in the shareholder's jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly permitted the prohibited activity are personally liable for statutory fines and the company's unpaid penalties; courts may pierce the veil and order civil restitution; directors face travel bans and removal from the Vanuatu register.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing the annual renewal declaration while maintaining only nominee directors, having no accounting records in Vanuatu for the green-coffee purchase/sale transactions, or failing to appoint a licensed registered agent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Strike-off and deregistration with asset vesting in VFSC; fines for false declarations under the IC Act; correspondent banks terminate SWIFT/LC facilities; transactions become unenforceable where the IC has ceased to exist.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Veil piercing where the IC is a facade; directors personally civilly liable for corporate obligations; disqualification from acting as directors for up to 5 years; travel bans while outstanding fines are unresolved.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to conduct due diligence on specialty-coffee buyers and suppliers, omitting beneficial-owner records at the registered agent, ignoring suspicious documentary-LC or SWIFT payment patterns (over-/under-invoicing of container shipments), or failing to file suspicious transaction reports.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Prosecution under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 30 of 2014: fines up to VUV 100 million for bodies corporate and imprisonment up to 25 years for individuals; VFSC administrative fines; freezing and confiscation of container proceeds; termination of banking relationships.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers and the appointed MLRO face personal criminal prosecution, imprisonment, extradition under mutual legal assistance treaties, and personal asset-confiscation orders.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Prohibited local business and unlicensed activity
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a Vanuatu-facing coffee distribution business, signing supply contracts with Vanuatu-resident importers, leasing Vanuatu storage facilities, or exercising management and control from Vanuatu without converting to a local company licensed under the Business Licence Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Offence under the International Companies Act for prohibited local business, with fines and daily default penalties; contracts with Vanuatu residents void or unenforceable; VFSC strike-off; Business Licence Act penalties for unlicensed trade.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Every director and officer participating in the prohibited transaction is personally liable for the statutory fine; the corporate veil is pierced for debts arising from the unlawful contracts; directors face imprisonment for continued non-compliance and travel restrictions pending payment.
